name: grad-first-job-pack
description: 31 Claude Skills for getting up to speed in your first job, from before day one to your first review: a company research brief from public sources, a Claude Project for the first 90 days and a first week plan; an AI policy card, a data check before you paste, an AI task picker, an output check and a disclosure note; a question log, a work glossary, a who does what map and a document explainer; a 30 60 90 day plan, first goals, a ways of working note, a weekly plan and a priority clash reply; emails to senior colleagues, meeting notes, spreadsheet checks, short reports, presentations and a mistake recovery note; a brag document, weekly updates, 1:1 agendas, feedback requests and first review prep; plus a weekly learning review, a stretch assignment ask and an internal network plan. For graduates starting their first job, placement and internship students, apprentices and anyone starting a new job. Each skill is one named method or one artifact, with the inputs it needs, where it breaks, a fixed output template, a finish line and the next skill to run.
